findings.name: dead space in a tile
findings.measured: 348.6px of empty band between content blocks at y=2501.4 and y=2850
findings.expected: no empty band of 48px or more inside a tile
findings.fix: Let the tile hug its content, fill it (a chart that fills its tile), or give the row a shorter tile.

findings.name: stretched part
findings.where: svg.spark-inline in 'Cash£929.3m+5.8% upvs start of perio'
findings.measured: scaled x1.153 by y0.917 (1.26x off), 1 text/circle and 0 raw-stroke mark(s) distorted
findings.expected: parts keep their proportions (≤10%% non-uniform)
findings.fix: Let the chart re-derive its geometry for the box (the fit engine) instead of preserveAspectRatio="none"; for images use object-fit:cover.
